name: Hampton Inn by Hilton Penn Yan
hoursNote: Check-in 3 pm, check-out noon
description: Full-service hotel on the shore of Keuka Lake in Penn Yan with free hot breakfast, indoor pool, fitness center, and lakeside patio with fire pit. Consistently rated among the top hotels in the Finger Lakes region.

name: Best Western Plus Vineyard Inn & Suites
hoursNote: Check-in 3 pm, check-out 11 am
description: Ranked #1 hotel in Penn Yan on TripAdvisor, this Best Western offers a heated indoor pool, hot tub, fitness center, and complimentary breakfast near the Keuka Lake Wine Trail. Pet-friendly rooms available.

name: Microtel by Wyndham Penn Yan Finger Lakes Region
hoursNote: Check-in 3 pm, check-out 11 am
description: Budget-friendly Wyndham hotel in downtown Penn Yan with complimentary breakfast and indoor pool; a convenient and well-reviewed base for exploring Keuka Lake and area wineries.

name: The Mansion at Keuka Lake
hoursNote: Check-in 3 pm; contact property for details
description: Boutique historic inn and restaurant in a beautifully restored 19th-century mansion perched on the east bluff of Keuka Lake at Keuka Park. Offers hotel rooms, fine dining, and event hosting with sweeping lake views.

name: Best Western Plus The Hammondsport Hotel
hoursNote: Check-in 3 pm, check-out 11 am
description: Modern hotel on Route 54 near Hammondsport with indoor pool, outdoor fire pits, and free hot breakfast; highly rated by guests and convenient to Keuka Lake, the Keuka Wine Trail, and the Glenn H. Curtiss Museum.

name: Keuka Lakeside Inn
hoursNote: Check-in 3 pm; contact property for details
description: Family-owned inn with 17 rooms and 230 feet of private Keuka Lake frontage in the heart of Hammondsport; #1-rated hotel in Hammondsport on TripAdvisor, ideal for fishing, kayaking, and walking to village shops.

name: Vinehurst Inn & Suites
hoursNote: Check-in 3 pm; contact property for details
description: Quiet 3.5-acre inn south of Hammondsport with spacious renovated rooms and suites including whirlpool options; complimentary continental breakfast and organic amenities included.

name: Keuka Lake Motel
hoursNote: Self check-in available; contact for details
description: Waterfront budget motel on the eastern shore of Keuka Lake with on-site Keg & Barrel Brewing Company taproom; located across from a public boat launch near Ravines Winery.

name: Keuka Cove Inn
address: 1756 West Lake Road, Penn Yan, NY 14527
hoursNote: Self check-in; contact property for details
description: Boutique 17-unit hilltop motel south of Penn Yan near Keuka Lake with streaming TVs, fiber internet, guest grill, and complimentary fire pit wood; close to Keuka College and local wineries.

name: The Laurentide Inn
hoursNote: Check-in 3–6 pm; contact property for details
description: Beautifully renovated historic B&B in downtown Penn Yan with multicourse gourmet breakfasts and a direct connection to Laurentide Brewing Company next door. Formerly the Fox Inn.

name: Trimmer House Bed & Breakfast
address: 145 E Main Street, Penn Yan, NY 14527
hoursNote: Check-in 3–6 pm; contact property for details
description: Charming five-room Victorian B&B in downtown Penn Yan featuring period furnishings, private baths, and gourmet breakfasts; steps from shops and a short drive to Keuka Lake and the wine trail.

name: Los Gatos Bed & Breakfast
hoursNote: Check-in 3–6 pm; contact property for details
description: Perennially top-rated B&B north of Penn Yan offering rooms in the main house and private log cabins; acclaimed for outstanding gourmet breakfasts, scenic decks, and stargazing on the grounds.

name: Aubergine Bed & Breakfast
hoursNote: Check-in 3–6 pm; contact property for details
description: Historic Victorian B&B in a quiet Penn Yan neighborhood with homemade breakfasts featuring fresh local ingredients; walkable to downtown shops and a short drive to Keuka Lake.

name: The Black Sheep Inn and Spa
hoursNote: Open year-round; check-in 3–6 pm
description: British-owned vegan-friendly inn and spa on the outskirts of Hammondsport near Keuka Lake; open year-round with acclaimed plant-based breakfasts and spa services, ranked #2 B&B in Hammondsport.

name: Amity Rose Bed & Breakfast
hoursNote: Check-in 3–6 pm; contact property for details
description: Warm family-run B&B near downtown Hammondsport hosted by proprietor Sandy; consistently praised for charming rooms, generous breakfasts, and a short walk to Keuka Lake and village restaurants.

name: Pleasant Valley Inn
hoursNote: Check-in 3 pm; contact property for details
description: Historic inn and acclaimed restaurant on Route 54 near Hammondsport offering comfortable lodging, a full-service pub, and proximity to the Keuka Lake Wine Trail.

name: Country Comforts Bed & Breakfast
hoursNote: Check-in 3–6 pm; contact property for details
description: Peaceful #1-rated B&B near Branchport about two miles from Keuka Lake, hosted by Brenda and Gary; celebrated for country breakfasts with fresh local eggs, warm hospitality, and a relaxing front porch.

name: Gone with the Wind on Keuka Lake
hoursNote: Check-in 3 pm; contact property by phone for reservations
description: Intimate 1887 Georgian stone mansion B&B on the west shore of Keuka Lake in Pulteney with themed rooms, lake-view verandas, home-cooked breakfasts, and access to a private swimming cove.

name: Feather Tick 'N Thyme Bed & Breakfast
hoursNote: Check-in 3–6 pm; contact property for details
description: Victorian country B&B on 220 acres between Canandaigua and Keuka Lakes near Prattsburgh (~8 miles west of Keuka); popular retreat for Finger Lakes wine country visitors and small weddings.

name: Keuka Lake State Park Campground
hoursNote: Open mid-May through mid-October; reserve sites at reserveamerica.com or by calling the park
description: NYS campground on Keuka Lake's west bluff peninsula with electric and non-electric tent/RV sites, restrooms with showers, and direct lake access; popular for swimming, boating, and fishing.

name: 1897 Beekman House Bed & Breakfast
hoursNote: Check-in 3–6 pm; contact property for details
description: Elegantly restored 1897 Victorian manor in Dundee, ranked #1 B&B in the area on TripAdvisor with 350+ reviews; approximately 6 miles east of Keuka Lake and convenient to the Keuka and Seneca wine trails.
